parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=13;fontColor=#232F3E;align=left;verticalAlign=top;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;spacing=0;" value="<b style="font-size:16px">Legend</b><ol style="padding-left:20px;margin-top:10px;margin-bottom:10px"><li style="margin-bottom:6px"><b>API client</b> calls the <b>HTTP API</b> over HTTPS (<font color="#5A6C86">/domains</font>, <font color="#5A6C86">/health</font>).</li><li style="margin-bottom:6px"><b>API Gateway</b> invokes the <b>API function</b> with the request.</li><li style="margin-bottom:6px">The function creates, reads and deletes domains in the <b>domains table</b> (on-demand capacity).</li><li style="margin-bottom:6px"><b>EventBridge Scheduler</b> starts the <b>checker function</b> once a day.</li><li style="margin-bottom:6px">The checker queries the domains due for a check and records each result.</li><li style="margin-bottom:6px">For each domain it opens a TLS connection on port 443 and reads the certificate's expiry date.</li><li style="margin-bottom:6px">Certificates inside the alert window are published to the <b>alerts topic</b>.</li><li style="margin-bottom:6px"><b>Amazon SNS</b> emails every confirmed subscriber.</li></ol>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="780" width="350" x="1320" y="140" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

ol.li: API client calls the HTTP API over HTTPS (/domains, /health).
API Gateway invokes the API function with the request.
The function creates, reads and deletes domains in the domains table (on-demand capacity).
EventBridge Scheduler starts the checker function once a day.
The checker queries the domains due for a check and records each result.
For each domain it opens a TLS connection on port 443 and reads the certificate's expiry date.
Certificates inside the alert window are published to the alerts topic.
Amazon SNS emails every confirmed subscriber.
